- When sentiment is positive (≥ 0.2), model tends to under-forecast; increase forecast slightly to align with bullish momentum.  
- When sentiment is negative (≤ -0.1), model often over-forecasts; reduce forecast to match bearish trend.  
- Model frequently overreacts to recent spikes (e.g., 65+), overshooting by 2–5 points; cap forecast at +3–4 above recent peak.  
- Model underestimates mean reversion in 30-day horizon; if 10–15 day mean is 1–2 points above recent low, adjust forecast upward.  
- Forecast errors cluster near 10–15 day horizon; for 30-day forecasts, apply 1–2 point lag correction if sentiment is neutral or mildly bullish.  
- If sentiment history shows repeated +0.23 spikes, model tends to miss subsequent rally; add 0.5–1.5 point buffer to forecast for next 3–5 days.
